entries.title: Company Overview
entries.answer: Vortexus Industrial Excellence supports water, energy, and automation systems. The company helps clients select, source, and support industrial water-treatment products, pumps, chemicals, instrumentation, controls, and complete system solutions.

entries.title: Contact Details
entries.answer: You can contact Vortexus by phone on 0702539456, email info@vortexusindustrial.com, or WhatsApp through https://wa.me/254710869870. Office/service locations listed on the site include Dar Es Salaam Road in Nairobi, Cabanas on Mombasa Road, and Mombasa.

entries.title: Product Categories
entries.answer: The product catalog covers filtration systems, reverse osmosis systems, industrial chemicals, disinfection systems, pumps and fluid handling, swimming pool systems, wastewater equipment, effluent treatment plants, sewage treatment plants, desalination, monitoring and instrumentation, automation and control, tanks, spare parts, recycling, reuse, and sludge handling.

entries.title: Pumps and Fluid Handling
entries.answer: Vortexus supports pump selection and supply for centrifugal pumps, dosing pumps, submersible pumps, booster systems, sludge pumps, valves, pipe fittings, and pump accessories. For accurate sizing, share flow rate, total dynamic head, fluid type, power supply, installation context, and duty cycle.

entries.title: Water Treatment
entries.answer: For water treatment, the right solution depends on the water problem. RO is used for dissolved salts, fluoride, conductivity, and high-purity needs. UF helps with suspended solids and microorganisms where dissolved salts are not the main issue. UV is for microbiological disinfection after water is clear enough for UV penetration. A water analysis report is the strongest starting point.

entries.title: Industrial Chemicals
entries.answer: The site lists industrial chemicals and media for coagulation, flocculation, disinfection, pH adjustment, corrosion control, scale inhibition, membrane cleaning, ion exchange resin, and treatment media. Chemical selection should match the process step, concentration, dosing purpose, and material compatibility.

entries.title: Automation and Instrumentation
entries.answer: Vortexus supports automation and instrumentation for treatment and pumping systems, including PLC systems, control panels, sensors, probes, pressure switches, cables, drives, inverters, remote monitoring, pH meters, TDS meters, turbidity meters, flow meters, pressure gauges, and online water analyzers.

entries.title: Solution Families
entries.answer: The solution families include borehole solutions, domestic water treatment, commercial and industrial water treatment, chemicals and media, water pumps, and solar solutions. These are organized around real site needs such as water access, purification, pumping, energy resilience, and treatment inputs.

entries.title: Borehole Solutions
entries.answer: Borehole services include solarization, equipping, rehabilitation, pump installation, pump lifting and lowering, flushing, diagnostics, covers, junction boxes, controllers, UPVC drop pipes, adaptor sets, electrodes, and smart metering support.

entries.title: RFQ and Quotation Support
entries.answer: For a strong RFQ, share the application, source water type, required flow rate, pressure needs, installation location, power supply, and whether it is a replacement or new system. For treatment products, include water analysis where possible. For pumps, share head, flow, suction conditions, and duty cycle.

entries.title: Delivery and Regional Support
entries.answer: Vortexus supports Kenya-wide delivery and regional buyers, with timelines depending on item type, urgency, stock position, and destination. For urgent breakdown sourcing, share the product name, size, duty, image, and what failed operationally.
